result.reason: The operative change reduces the automatic-renewal notice period from 90 to 30 days, satisfying the fallback requirement of no more than 60 days and retaining 12-month renewal periods. The clause grants no unilateral price-increase right, so adding a price cap here is unnecessary. The edit is narrowly tailored and preserves the remaining commercial terms, though the inherited termination wording is slightly awkward and no 60-day reminder is added, so it does not fully achieve the preferred position.
